paragraphs.text: Chameleon is a silver-bordered creature type used for cards that depict a species of reptile covered in scales that can change color to camouflage itself.

Chameleon debuted as a creature type in Unsanctioned on a hybrid creature with multiple species with its tail & hands being that of a Chameleon. In their two appearances on eternal legal cards, they have been represented via the Lizard type.
Surgeon General Commander — a legendary humanoid intelligent Wombat Bat Chameleon hybrid.
